costs.text: 100 USDT a position, 0.1% of the order value on each buy and each sell

trading.rule: long when the predicted bin is in the upper half: the stake bought at the previous close, sold at the day's close, a fee on each leg; flat otherwise
trading.hold_rule: the same calls, but a position is kept while the calls stay up and sold at the close of the last up day: one fee pair per run, the stake compounds
trading.short_rule: with shorts on, a bin in the lower half is a short: sold at the previous close and bought back at the day's close (daily), kept while the call stays down (hold), sold at the open and bought back at the close (open to close); paper only - selling what one does not own needs a margin or derivatives account

orders.rule: buy at market when the day card appears, a sell limit at X (the predicted bin's lower edge from the previous close), sold at the limit or at market when the next day card appears (12:00 UTC the next day at the latest); the same coin called up again with its new limit at least 0.30 % above the price keeps the position and only moves the limit

variants.edge: the predicted bin's lower edge from the base close: when the call comes true the close is at least X, so a right call fills
variants.mid: the predicted bin's representative return from the base close: the predicted price the pages draw
variants.fixed: the entry price plus 1 % (day) or 4 % (week): a control that ignores the bin

orders.review: one review, at 60 live day orders or 31 Jan 2027, whichever is later: switch only if another variant beats the primary in a paired per-order comparison with the lower bound of the mean difference above 0, and with the owner's decision
orders.newcomer_rule: on a day card that rolls a held position (the same coin called up again, its new limit at least 0.30 % above the price), a reader who did not buy on the earlier card is told to buy now: each such showing is booked as a newcomer entry - bought at the price when that card appeared, the same new limit, sold at the limit or at market when the next day card appears (12:00 UTC the next day at the latest), under the same no-order tests as a fresh day order, and rolled like the main position when the next card calls the coin up again - in a separate record
